subject: How to code NIL genotype in R/qtl?

messages.author: 7c608cd8b564454f
messages.subject: How to code NIL genotype in R/qtl?
parts:
Hello, 

I have NIL (near isogenic lines) with me to conduct quality control with R/qtl. But I don't know how to code for the genotype. Can R/qtl handle NIL lines and how can I code for the recurrent alleles and donor allele?

Ant light you can shed on this issue will be much appreciated.

Thanks!

Catherine

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] How to code NIL genotype in R/qtl?
parts:
R/qtl doesn't have any specific support for NILs. You could try
importing them as if they were RILs (using crosstype="riself" in
read.cross).

The genotypes can be encoded in a variety of ways but need to indicate
the parental origins of alleles, for example AA/BB or A/B.

karl
